parole.significato: A major Chinese school of Mahayana Buddhism characterized by sudden enlightenment achieved by indirect means, developed…
parole.testo: Borrowed from the pinyin romanization of the Mandarin pronunciation of Chinese 禪 /禅 (Chán), a development and clipping of Middle Chinese 禪那 (MC dzyen na), a transcription of Sanskrit ध्यान (dhyāna, literally “meditation”). Doublet of dhyana and Zen.

parole.significato: Any of several minerals discovered by the Chang'e series of lunar landers and Yutu series of lunar rovers
parole.testo: From Chang'e + -s- + -ite. Named after Chinese goddess Chang'e (the moon goddess). Named for the Chang'e program, the Chinese lunar landers which discovered the minerals. From Mandarin Cháng'é (“ㄔㄤˊ ㄜˊ”) (Ch‘ang²-ê²), from Chinese 嫦娥 (Cháng'é).

parole.significato: Synonym of picul: a traditional unit of weight and mass, chiefly used as a dry measure of grains.
parole.testo: From the pinyin romanization of the Mandarin pronunciation of Chinese 担 (dàn) and Chinese 石 (dàn).
From the Hanyu Pinyin romanization of the Mandarin pronunciation of Chinese 豆腐 (dòufu). Doublet of tofu and dubu.

parole.significato: The imperial Chinese board of revenue, especially its branch in Guangzhou during the Qing Dynasty.
parole.testo: Uncertain, although probably an irregular romanization of the Mandarin pronunciation of Chinese 戶部 /户部 (Hùbù), the imperial government's Board of Revenue which oversaw customs and other taxation during the Qing Dynasty. In reference to its agents, a clipping of earlier hoppo-man.

parole.significato: A class of Chinese alcoholic beverages made from fermented grains including rice, millet, and wheat, typically 10–20% a…
parole.testo: The atonal pinyin romanization of the Mandarin pronunciation of Chinese 黃酒 /黄酒 (huángjiǔ, “yellow alcohol”). Compare baijiu.
A partial calque of the Mandarin form of Chinese 臘八粥 /腊八粥 (làbāzhōu), named for its association with the Laba Festival.

parole.significato: A kind of congee traditionally made with 8 variable vegetarian flavorings and consumed during the Laba Festival.
parole.testo: A partial calque of the Mandarin form of Chinese 臘八粥 /腊八粥 (làbāzhōu), named for its association with the Laba Festival.

parole.significato: Synonym of tael, a former Chinese unit of weight (about 40 g) and a related unit of silver currency.
parole.testo: The atonal Wade-Giles and pinyin romanization of the standard Mandarin pronunciation of Chinese 兩 /两 (liǎng). Doublet of leung and yang.
From romanizations of the Mandarin pronunciation of Chinese 鵬 /鹏 (péng).

parole.significato: A phonetic script or romanization system for various languages spoken in the People's Republic of China, e.g. Tibetan
parole.testo: 20th c., from Mandarin Chinese 拼音 (pīnyīn, literally “spelled sounds”).

parole.significato: A kind of fermented dark Assam green tea (C. sinensis var. assamica).
parole.testo: Shortened from pu'er tea, from the pinyin romanization of the Mandarin pronunciation of Chinese 普洱茶 (pǔ'ěrchá).

parole.significato: An ancient Chinese unit of volume, notionally equivalent to the space occupied by 1200 millet seeds.
parole.testo: The atonal pinyin romanization of the standard Mandarin pronunciation of Chinese 龠 (yuè).

parole.testo: The atonal pinyin romanization of the standard Mandarin pronunciation of Chinese 籥 (yuè).

parole.testo: The atonal pinyin romanization of the standard Mandarin pronunciation of Chinese 筑 (zhù or zhú).
